incidents.text: Goal! Mahmoud Saber (Egypt) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
Mehdi Taremi (Iran) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
Oufa Shobeir anticipates the direction of the penalty by Mehdi Taremi (Iran). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
GOAL! Ramin Rezaeian (Iran) threads the eye of the needle and scores from an almost impossible angle from close in!
Hossam Hassan is forced to make a change. Mohamed Abdelmonem is unable to continue due to injury, Yasser Ibrahim (Egypt) comes on.
This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hossein Kanaani (Iran) was quite harsh and Szymon Marciniak didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
Szymon Marciniak shows a yellow card to Mahmoud Saber (Egypt) for his blatant foul.
Yasser Ibrahim (Egypt) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
Ali Nemati (Iran) has tested the patience of referee Szymon Marciniak and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
Half-time substitution. Hossein Kanaani (Iran) will not participate anymore and Saleh Hardani is coming on.
Here is a change after the half-time break. Emam Ashour is replaced by Omar Marmoush (Egypt).
Hossam Hassan has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Marwan Attia (Egypt) comes on the pitch for Mahmoud Saber.
Problems for Hossam Hassan as Mohamed Salah is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Zizo (Egypt) replaces him.
We are about to witness a subsitution. Shahriyar Moghanlou (Iran) for Saman Ghoddos.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hamza Abdelkarim (Egypt) comes onto the pitch for Mostafa Ziko.
The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Saeid Ezatolahi (Iran).
Amir Ghalenoei has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran) replacing Mohammad Mohebi.
Mohanad Lasheen (Egypt) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
Shoja Khalilzadeh (Iran) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
